answer: Why must agents scribble their witness scrolls with indelible ink from a living walnut tree? Because only the tree’s annulus ring pieces pre-date the epoch passport—each Sybil must harvest a new scroll. The ink’s opal sheen changes under pulses calibrated to a single block’s saffron wavelength, costing 0.07 joules of tunable fluorescence per head; parallel farms cannot match the pulse’s quantum erosion schedule.
